limits: Every known location is visited. Equivalent transaction handlers are covered by their identical ROM goods group, not every cross-product of place and inventory.

limits: The Saylun already-owned-apple branch uses one explicitly declared money refill for a real purchase, plus declared approach protection. No item or quest flag is injected.
These receipts close the requested SMS equipment/hint/chimney/corrosion checks. They do not certify every possible inventory permutation or the paired MD graphics/audio behavior.

fb_npc.conclusion: The wrapper calls 050C once, waits for input and jumps to 1DE2. It does not display returned HL or the adjacent 9A58/9A7C strings.

halls_npc.conclusion: This handler selects one of exactly two strings then jumps to 6277. It has no Ice Bell branch and never selects AD3C.

limits: Only selected recordings with an independent fixed replay are admitted.
Formatter/wrapper return pointers do not identify displayed strings.
Not observing a string cannot prove it unreachable. No quest trigger or ROM change is invented.

reconciliation.classification: Adjacent ordinary/conditional NPC routes excluded; no observed gameplay omission established; another trigger is not ruled out globally.
reconciliation.remaining_requirement: Complete call/data-flow proof for every text entry path, or an actual source trigger for the three strings. Absence of a raw pointer alone is insufficient.

remaining: Prove code boundaries and eliminate data/overlapping byte candidates.
Resolve computed and indirect control flow, argument origins and all formatter re-entry paths.
Do not infer global unreachability from direct operands or repeated runtime prefixes.
